<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914805_theRebbe_603" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914805_theRebbe_603__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Although the two interpretations of "Lech Lecha" are opposite, the single word proves it includes both a descent and ascent, paralleling "Vehithalachti" and "Komemiyut."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, although the two above explanations of "Lech Lecha" are two different and opposite explanations,</t>
    <t s="2">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="3">since both explanations are in the same word</t>
    <t s="4">(the word Lech),</t>
    <t s="5">it is proven from this,</t>
    <t s="6">that the concept of "Lech Lecha"</t>
    <t s="7">[and the instruction to every Jew in this portion]</t>
    <t s="8">includes both modes together,</t>
    <t s="9">a movement from above to below and a movement from below to above.</t>
    <t s="10">And analogous to "And I will walk among you"</t>
    <t s="11">where "Vehithalachti"</t>
    <t s="12">(plural form)</t>
    <t s="13">includes</t>
    <t s="14">the two aspects of movement mentioned above.</t>
    <t s="15">And so too regarding the matter of "And I will lead you erect,"</t>
    <t s="16">where "Komemiyut"</t>
    <t s="17">(plural form)</t>
    <t s="18">indicates two levels</t>
    <t s="19">[the level of direct light and the level of reflected light,</t>
    <t s="20">which are analogous to the two aspects of movement mentioned above],</t>
    <t s="21">the intention in this is that "Komemiyut" includes both levels together.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This year, a leap year completing a small cycle, unites sun and moon, representing the two movements of bestower and receiver, making them one.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one can connect this with this year</t>
    <t s="1">(in particular),</t>
    <t s="2">which is a leap year,</t>
    <t s="3">and moreover it is the leap year of the completion of a small cycle,</t>
    <t s="4">in which the alignment of the solar year with the lunar year is made</t>
    <t s="5">(in perfect completeness).</t>
    <t s="6">For the sun is an aspect of bestower – analogous to the concept of movement from above to below,</t>
    <t s="7">and the moon</t>
    <t s="8">(which has nothing of its own)</t>
    <t s="9">is an aspect of receiver – analogous to the concept of movement from below to above.</t>
    <t s="10">And the concept of the leap year</t>
    <t s="11">(and particularly the leap year of the completion of a small cycle)</t>
    <t s="12">is the combination and connection of the two services</t>
    <t s="13">[the service of the sun</t>
    <t s="14">(aspect of bestower,</t>
    <t s="15">movement from above to below,</t>
    <t s="16">which in general is</t>
    <t s="17">the service of the righteous),</t>
    <t s="18">and the service of the moon</t>
    <t s="19">(aspect of receiver,</t>
    <t s="20">movement from below to above,</t>
    <t s="21">which in general is</t>
    <t s="22">the service of the penitents)],</t>
    <t s="23">that they become one matter</t>
    <t s="24">(a complete year),</t>
    <t s="25">as explained above</t>
    <t s="26">at length.</t>
    <t s="27">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="28">"And our eyes will shine like the sun and the moon,"</t>
    <t s="29">the intention in this is</t>
    <t s="30">[not only that there will be the two virtues,</t>
    <t s="31">the virtue of the sun and the virtue of the moon, but also]</t>
    <t s="32">that the two matters</t>
    <t s="33">(and virtues)</t>
    <t s="34">will be as one.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The unification of these two services prepares a vessel for drawing down the Ein Sof, which transcends above and below, culminating in the revelation of Atzmus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this matter</t>
    <t s="1">[the combination and unification of the two above matters]</t>
    <t s="2">is a preparation and vessel</t>
    <t s="3">[and in a manner of a limb,</t>
    <t s="4">which is not only a receiver but also draws down]</t>
    <t s="5">for the drawing down of the Ein Sof, which is beyond the category of "above and below."</t>
    <t s="6">[And in the manner known,</t>
    <t s="7">that after the completeness of arousal from below</t>
    <t s="8">(aspect of the moon)</t>
    <t s="9">and the revelation of arousal from above</t>
    <t s="10">(aspect of the sun)</t>
    <t s="11">(drawn down through arousal from below),</t>
    <t s="12">afterward an arousal from above is drawn from a place that arousal from below does not reach there at all].</t>
    <t s="13">For the completeness of the service</t>
    <t s="14">[in the combination of the two above matters,</t>
    <t s="15">a complete year]</t>
    <t s="16">is the complete site,</t>
    <t s="17">which is a vessel for the indwelling of the Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="18">for the Holy One, blessed be He, dwells in a complete site.</t>
    <t s="19">And until that through this is made the drawing down of the Awtsmoos, which is the true and ultimate completeness.</t>
    <t s="20">And Israel and the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="21">(through the Torah)</t>
    <t s="22">become entirely one,</t>
    <t s="23">and in a manner that it is not possible to distinguish between them,</t>
    <t s="24">since the Torah of truth testifies that they are one.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Although the two interpretations of "Lech Lecha" are opposite, the single word proves it includes both a descent and ascent, paralleling "Vehithalachti" and "Komemiyut."

translations.translation: And behold, although the two above explanations of "Lech Lecha" are two different and opposite explanations,
since both explanations are in the same word
[and the instruction to every Jew in this portion]
a movement from above to below and a movement from below to above.
And analogous to "And I will walk among you"
the two aspects of movement mentioned above.
And so too regarding the matter of "And I will lead you erect,"
[the level of direct light and the level of reflected light,
which are analogous to the two aspects of movement mentioned above],
the intention in this is that "Komemiyut" includes both levels together.
